baseline.description: AWS downlink baseline: QPSK, rate 1/2, RS(255,223) I=5, long randomizer.

high_throughput.description: Minimal FEC overhead: rate 7/8 punctured, RS(255,239) I=1 -- maximizes bit rate/bandwidth efficiency, at the cost of weaker error correction.

robust_bpsk.description: Maximum robustness: BPSK, unpunctured rate 1/2, RS(255,223) I=8, wider roll-off for extra timing tolerance.

legacy_compat.description: Same coding as baseline but with the 255-bit legacy randomizer, for receivers predating the 131071-bit default (Issue 5, 2023).
